description: This file defines a PHP class 'Language' which functions as a controller for managing localisation languages within the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, deleting, and generating language data, interacting with models and views, and integrating with session and request data.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class in the Opencart admin module for managing localisation languages, providing CRUD operations, state toggling, and data export functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that sets up the language management page, loads language strings, and prepares the view with necessary data and sub-views.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Short method that outputs the result of getList, primarily to serve AJAX requests or link loads.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares a list of languages from the database, including pagination, sorting, and links for editing and actions; returns the rendered HTML view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Handles rendering the form for adding or editing a language, populates fields with existing data if available.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of a language's data, either creating or updating based on the presence of 'language_id'. Performs validation and permission checks, responds with JSON.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected languages by updating their status; responds with JSON indicating success or errors.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected languages similarly to enable; updates status and responds accordingly.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected languages after validation checks, ensuring they are not default or linked to existing stores/orders.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Exports language data to a JSON file in the catalog view data directory, used for caching or external processing.
